sections.heading: Long-Term Commitment
paragraphs: According to AutoRacing1.com, Gabriel Bortoleto has committed to a long-term future in Formula 1, indicating his dedication to the sport.

sections.heading: Views on Artificial Intelligence
paragraphs: FormulaPassion reports that Bortoleto has defended the use of artificial intelligence in Formula 1, stating, "Siamo la F1, se non l'usiamo noi..." which translates to "We are F1, if we don't use it...", highlighting the importance of embracing technology in the sport.

sections.heading: Current Sentiments in Formula 1
paragraphs: Autosprint discusses the general sentiment among pilots regarding the power units used in Formula 1, with Bortoleto being a notable voice in these discussions.

faq.q: What is Gabriel Bortoleto's stance on artificial intelligence in Formula 1?
faq.a: Bortoleto supports the use of artificial intelligence, as quoted in FormulaPassion, "Siamo la F1, se non l'usiamo noi...", emphasizing the sport's role in adopting such technology.

faq.q: What is the significance of Bortoleto's long-term commitment to Formula 1?
faq.a: As reported by AutoRacing1.com, Bortoleto's long-term commitment signifies his dedication and investment in the future of the sport, which can influence its development and direction.
